defect: The new __KernelSwitchToThread calls __KernelChangeReadyState(current, threadID, true) with the target thread's id instead of the current thread's id (copied from __KernelSwitchOffThread, where threadID meant currentThread), corrupting the ready queues.
reason: The fix replaces threadID with currentThread in exactly this line, which the change added, and the parameter shadowing the local of the copied function is visible in the diff.

defect: The fix sign-extends the delay-slot immediate so the zero-extended u32 field no longer compares unequal to a negative branch offset, which only removes a spurious 'different target' error report for backward branches.
reason: The signed/unsigned mismatch was already in the old line (u32 field against the signed offset), so backward branches misreported both before and after this change; the change made forward branches correct and introduced no new wrong behaviour, and the effect is only a diagnostic log.

defect: NiceTimeFormat fetches the Dialog i18n category but formats with the literal English strings, so the time shown in the new exit-confirmation dialog is never translated.
reason: The same commit added the '%d seconds/minutes/hours' keys to every language file and the fix routes the strings through di->T_cstr; the unused di is visible in the diff.

defect: In the new exponent-decrease step, (rate_ + 3) / 4 is computed in signed int, so a rate near 0x7FFFFFFF overflows (undefined behaviour, in practice a negative value that makes the envelope rise instead of fall).
reason: The fix casts rate_ to u32 in this line, which the change added; seeing the overflow needs rate_'s int declaration in SasAudio.h (the diff only hints at it through the (s64) casts and the removed rate comments).

defect: '#ifdef __ANDROID__ && __ANDROID_API__ < 21' is an invalid directive: #ifdef tests only __ANDROID__ and ignores the extra tokens, so every Android build, not only API < 21, uses 32-bit stat instead of stat64.
reason: The fix replaces exactly this added line with a proper '#if (defined __ANDROID__) && (__ANDROID_API__ < 21)', and the malformed #ifdef is visible in the diff.

defect: The window title was changed from "PPSSPP v0.6 - " to PPSSPP_VERSION_STR " - ", and since PPSSPP_VERSION_STR is just "0.6.1" the program name disappears from the title.
reason: The fix adds the missing "PPSSPP " prefix to this changed line; knowing that the macro lacks the name needs Core/Config.h (the effect is cosmetic, and the wide-string path converts 'message' rather than 'title', an older bug).

defect: When a mip level has the wrong size it is skipped but the loop continues, so a later correctly sized level is pushed into levels_ at the wrong index and is used as the wrong mip level.
reason: The skip-without-break logic is new in this change and the fix adds the missing break after a bad level, which a reviewer can see from the loop in the diff.

defect: The SDL main passes a plain DummyGraphicsContext to NativeInitGraphics, whose CreateThin3DContext returns nullptr, so thin3d is null on SDL (Linux/Mac) builds.
reason: The fix replaces it with a GLDummyGraphicsContext that returns T3DCreateGLContext(); seeing the null context needs Common/GraphicsContext.h and NativeInitGraphics in UI/NativeApp.cpp.

defect: The new RegCountToType returns type 4 for a four-register VLD1/VST1, but the ARM encoding for four registers is 0b0010, so VLD1/VST1 with n=4 emit the wrong instruction.
reason: RegCountToType is new in this change and the fix changes exactly that return value from 4 to 2, checkable against the encoding table from the diff alone.

defect: The new 'Savedata Manager' choice is looked up in the Networking i18n category (n->T) instead of the Savedata category, so its translation is not found.
reason: The line was added by this change and the fix switches it to a Savedata category; using the networking category in the Tools tab is visible in the diff.

defect: The guard '#if !defined(_M_ARM64) && !defined(_M_ARM)' meant to disable GLES on Windows ARM also disables it on 32-bit ARM Linux/Android, because Core/MemMap.h defines _M_ARM there.
reason: The fix restricts both guards this change added to Windows; that _M_ARM is defined on non-Windows ARM needs Core/MemMap.h.

defect: The new SyncThread wait condition '(eventsRunning_ || !eventsHaveRun_)' keeps waiting forever when the GPU thread has never run, so SyncThread(true) on stop before run hangs.
reason: Before the change the loop waited only while eventsRunning_; the fix adds an exit when the thread is not running and the core is stopping, and the hang path depends on the System.cpp shutdown caller.

defect: The new depth clamping does 'far += overageFar' instead of 'far -= overageFar', so it pushes the far value further out instead of clamping it into [0, 1].
reason: The fix flips exactly this added line, and the mismatch with the analogous 'right -= overageRight' and 'bottom -= overageBottom' is visible in the diff.

defect: OnSavePathOther writes installed.txt through a narrow std::ofstream::open on the UTF-8 exe path, which fails on Windows when the PPSSPP folder contains non-ASCII letters.
reason: git blame shows the ofstream/open/close lines the fix replaces with File::OpenCFile come from this change; the same diff reads the file with ConvertUTF8ToWString, so the asymmetry is visible (the pattern existed elsewhere, but this instance is new).
